pages.title: King Dedede Smiling with His Giant Wooden Hammer Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede smiles with his giant wooden hammer in this printable coloring page, wearing a pompom cap, a fur-trimmed robe, and a patterned waistband. The star on the hammer and triangular clothing panels add enclosed details, while the large robe and feet leave broad spaces on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: King Dedede Eating a Royal Feast of Fruit and Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dedede enjoying a royal feast of fruit and cake, holding a strawberry on a fork beside a layered slice. A pineapple, grapes, apples, and a decorated cake fill the table, giving this coloring sheet many small food shapes around his large central figure.

pages.title: King Dedede Inhaling as Kirby Braces Against the Wind Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede inhales as Kirby braces against the wind in this printable coloring page, with curved gust lines sweeping toward Dedede's wide-open mouth and outstretched hands. Kirby crouches in the foreground, and scattered grass tufts keep the ground simple. The coloring sheet combines broad character shapes with finer robe trim.

pages.title: King Dedede Puffing Up and Floating Above His Mountain Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede puffs up and floats above his mountain castle in this printable coloring page, stretching his arms outward over round towers, flags, and clouds. His oversized belly dominates the composition, while rocky peaks and small windows add detail below. The coloring sheet offers large clothing areas alongside smaller architectural shapes.

pages.title: King Dedede Sliding on His Belly Toward Kirby Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dedede sliding on his belly toward Kirby, with both gloved hands extended and motion lines trailing across the ground. Kirby stands to one side among sparse grass tufts. Broad open spaces in the characters contrast with the smaller cap, robe trim, and facial details.

pages.title: King Dedede Batting a Spiky Gordo with His Hammer in Super Smash Bros Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede bats a spiky Gordo with his hammer in this printable coloring page inspired by Super Smash Bros, gripping the handle with both hands. The star-marked hammer swings overhead beside Gordo's pointed silhouette. Fur trim and triangular waistband panels provide smaller sections across the otherwise broad character shapes.

pages.title: King Dedede Facing Kirby in the Boxing Ring at Mt. Dedede Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places King Dedede and Kirby in the boxing ring at Mt. Dedede, with Dedede raising his star-marked hammer beside the ropes. A steep mountain and small castle rise behind them. The coloring sheet pairs large character areas with narrow ring ropes and simple mountain contours.

pages.title: King Dedede Racing Kirby Past Piles of Food in Gourmet Race Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede races Kirby past piles of food in this Gourmet Race printable coloring page, with strawberry cakes, cherries, and a large apple lining the course. Rounded hills and clouds sit behind the running characters. Food decorations and Dedede's patterned waistband add smaller shapes throughout this busy coloring sheet.

pages.title: King Dedede Bouncing Across Giant Drums and Collecting Coins in Drum Dash Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede bounces across giant drums and reaches for coins in this Drum Dash printable coloring page, with musical-note symbols inside the floating round tokens. Three drums form a staggered path beneath him. Their zigzag lacing and circular rims create repeated details around Dedede's broad robe and raised arms.

pages.title: King Dedede Riding His Custom Wheelie Bike in Kirby Air Ride Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features King Dedede riding his custom Wheelie bike from Kirby Air Ride, gripping the handlebars above a huge front tire and star emblem. A row of exhaust pipes extends along the side. Curved wheel sections and smaller mechanical panels give the coloring sheet varied enclosed spaces.

pages.title: King Dedede as Masked Dedede Wielding His Mechanical Hammer Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede appears as Masked Dedede in this printable coloring page, holding a mechanical hammer with a star-shaped face, bolted rims, and a segmented handle. His angular mask has narrow eye openings and rectangular vents. The coloring sheet combines these small mechanical details with large sleeves and fur-edged robe panels.

pages.title: King Dedede as Masked Dedede's Revenge Wielding a Battle Axe with His Mask Broken Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dedede in his Masked Dedede's Revenge form, holding a battle axe beside a cracked mask with broken sections around one eye. The axe carries a central star and pointed ornaments. Fine fractures and weapon details contrast with broad robe panels on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: King Dedede Controlled By Taranza's Magic Strings in Kirby Triple Deluxe Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dedede controlled by Taranza's magic strings in Kirby Triple Deluxe, standing with a hammer beneath Taranza's six hovering hands. Pillars and star banners frame the scene. Thin strings, mask panels, and hammer bolts add fine details around Dedede's larger robe sections.

pages.title: King Dedede as Forgo Dedede Wearing a Beast Mask and Carrying Two Hammers Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede appears as Forgo Dedede in this printable coloring page, wearing a horned beast mask and carrying two hammers above a floor scattered with rocks. Jagged fur edges, oval robe markings, and cracked hammer surfaces make this coloring sheet more detailed than a plain character portrait.

pages.title: King Dedede Resting Beside His Attendant in Waddle Dee Town Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede rests beside his attendant in Waddle Dee Town in this printable coloring page, smiling with closed eyes and one hand on the smaller character's head. A rounded house, fence, and low hills complete the setting. The coloring sheet has wide character shapes with smaller window and grass details.

pages.title: King Dedede Rescuing a Fallen Waddle Dee Beside the Elevator Leading to Lab Discovera Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dedede rescuing a fallen Waddle Dee beside the elevator to Lab Discovera, reaching down to hold the seated character's hand. A star emblem tops the elevator doors behind them. Simple floor tiles and broad robe panels keep most coloring areas open and clearly separated.

pages.title: King Dedede Riding His Hot Air Balloon Above Dedede Resort in Kirby Mass Attack Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede rides a hot air balloon above Dedede Resort in this Kirby Mass Attack printable coloring page, leaning over a basket decorated with a star. Another star marks the balloon canopy, while a small island, castle, and palm tree appear below. Curved canopy panels provide especially large coloring spaces.

pages.title: King Dedede Bathing in the Fountain of Dreams Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede bathes in the Fountain of Dreams in this printable coloring page, smiling with closed eyes and resting his hands on the decorated basin's rim. Water streams fall from a smaller bowl beneath a large star. Repeated stars, petal-shaped panels, and ripples give the coloring sheet distinct sections.

pages.title: King Dedede Dividing the Star Rod Into Seven Pieces Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dedede dividing the Star Rod into seven pieces, with two short sections in his hands and the remaining pieces on a table. The star-shaped tip sits prominently beside the cylindrical parts. Dedede's cap, sleeves, and triangular waistband offer larger areas around the small rod segments.

pages.title: King Dedede Tossing Eggs Toward Kirby in Egg Catcher Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede tosses eggs toward Kirby in this Egg Catcher printable coloring page, holding a woven basket while a spotted egg arcs toward Kirby's open mouth. Curved motion lines show the throw, and scattered grass tufts mark the ground. Basket bands and egg spots add smaller enclosed shapes.

pages.title: King Dedede as a Yarn Puppet Controlled By Strings in Kirby's Epic Yarn Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede becomes a yarn puppet in this Kirby's Epic Yarn printable coloring page, suspended beneath crossed control bars with strings attached to his body and hammer. Twisted cord borders and dashed seams outline his clothing. A patchwork floor adds angular sections beneath the puppet's rounded shapes.

pages.title: King Dedede Striking a Bell and Collecting Beads in Dedede Gogogo Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dedede striking a hanging bell and collecting beads in Dedede Gogogo, raising a star-marked hammer toward the bell's curved rim. Three round beads follow a dotted path nearby. Stitched outlines and twisted borders add small repeated details to his cap, robe, and shoes.

pages.title: King Dedede in His Samurai Kirby Outfit Facing Kirby with a Wooden Mochi Mallet Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede faces Kirby with a wooden mochi mallet in this Samurai Kirby printable coloring page, wearing a tied robe and gripping the long handle. Kirby stands below the raised mallet amid small grass tufts. Wood-grain marks and a knotted sash distinguish the clothing and prop on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: King Dedede Piloting Robo Dedede in Kirby's Dream Course Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede pilots Robo Dedede in this Kirby's Dream Course printable coloring page, holding two controls inside the open cockpit of a round mechanical body. A winding key, riveted panels, and jointed arms surround the robot's face. Tiled ground and a small golf flag add background detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: King Dedede Presenting the Giant Cake Prize at Dedede's Cake Royale Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede presents the giant cake prize at Dedede's Cake Royale in this printable coloring page, gesturing toward stacked tiers covered with strawberries and cream swirls. Curtains frame the raised cake stand and stage. The coloring sheet balances the large character with many small toppings and repeated scalloped icing bands.

pages.title: King Dedede as Waning Crescent Masked Dedede in Kirby Fighters 2 Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede takes his Waning Crescent Masked Dedede form in this Kirby Fighters 2 printable coloring page, holding a spiked hammer with a crescent emblem. A sweeping crescent also rises from his ornate mask. Curled mask edges and a central gem add fine sections above his broad robe and patterned waistband.

pages.title: King Dedede and Bandana Waddle Dee Bringing a Missing Ship Part Back to Magolor Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dedede and Bandana Waddle Dee returning a missing ship part to Magolor, who floats beside them with outstretched hands. The star-marked part has rivets and a fin, and the larger ship rests behind them. Mechanical panels and scarf details surround the rounded character shapes.

pages.title: King Dedede Passing a Bomb with a Frying Pan in Merry Magoland's Bomb Rally Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede passes a bomb with a frying pan in this Merry Magoland's Bomb Rally printable coloring page, holding the pan beneath a round bomb with a sparking fuse. Curved motion marks follow the upward swing. A plain background keeps the coloring sheet focused on the pan, costume, and action pose.

pages.title: King Dedede Dressed as a Ninja Throwing a Star at a Target in Ninja Dojo Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede dresses as a ninja and throws a star at a target in this Ninja Dojo printable coloring page, extending one hand from a hooded outfit. A tied sash and crosshatched fabric panels distinguish his costume. The round target and its wooden stand add clear geometric sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: King Dedede Riding a Smash Star and Bumping a Squeaker in Smash Ride Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede rides a Smash Star and bumps a Squeaker in this Smash Ride printable coloring page, with a jagged impact mark between their star-emblazoned vehicles. The Squeaker grips its ride beneath large rounded ears. Curving motion lines and a star-patterned arena wall give the coloring sheet a busy racing setting.

pages.title: King Dedede Punching a Boulder in Merry Magoland's Crackity Hack Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dedede punching a boulder in Merry Magoland's Crackity Hack, with his gloved fist pressed against the fractured rock's top. Cracks spread down the boulder, and loose stones surround its base. Dedede's broad sleeves and cap contrast with the irregular rock sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: King Dedede Riding Through Cappy Town with Escargoon in the Royal Racecar Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede rides through Cappy Town with Escargoon in the royal racecar in this printable coloring page, steering past mushroom-shaped houses and a distant castle. Escargoon sits beside him wearing a bow tie. Circular headlights, thick tires, and the crown-and-star grille create distinct vehicle details across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: King Dedede Watching His Kirby Printer Produce a Copy of Kirby Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dedede watching his Kirby printer produce a copy of Kirby, with a small round figure emerging onto the machine's tray. The printer itself has Kirby-like eyes, cheeks, and side arms. Broad machine panels and robe sections surround the smaller faces and paper-feed details.

pages.title: King Dedede Catching Falling Fruit in a Basket in Bumper Crop Bump Coloring Page
pages.description: King Dedede catches falling fruit in a basket in this Bumper Crop Bump printable coloring page, looking upward as an apple drops from a leafy branch. He grips both sides of the woven basket. Its narrow bands and the apple's leaf offer small details among the larger robe and cap shapes.

pages.title: Kirby King Dedede in Bamboo Grove Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and King Dedede stand in a bamboo grove in this printable coloring page, with Dedede carrying a star-marked hammer among tall segmented stalks and pointed leaves. Small stones and grass border the path inside a rectangular frame. The coloring sheet combines broad character areas with dense vertical plant details.

pages.title: Kirby King Dedede in Enchanted Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Kirby and King Dedede in an enchanted forest, each carrying a hammer along a winding path beneath a smiling sun. Spiral-marked trees, flowers, floating leaves, and a distant castle surround them. The coloring sheet includes many small woodland shapes around the two larger characters.

pages.title: Kirby King Dedede in Underwater Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and King Dedede explore an underwater kingdom in this printable coloring page, floating among small fish, rising bubbles, branching coral, and a locked treasure chest. Dedede carries his star-marked hammer beside Kirby. Curving seaweed and rounded seabed shapes add varied sections around the larger characters on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kirby King Dedede in Seaside Village Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kirby and King Dedede beside a seaside village, with a winding road, small houses, a sailboat, and a distant lighthouse. Dedede holds his hammer over one shoulder. Broad water and sky areas contrast with the village windows, fences, and boat rigging on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kirby King Dedede in Space Station Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and King Dedede visit a space station in this printable coloring page, standing near a control console and a round window showing planets and stars. Kirby raises a star wand while Dedede carries a hammer marked with a letter. Small buttons and window details contrast with large wall panels.

pages.title: Kirby King Dedede in Cookie Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and King Dedede walk through a cookie forest in this printable coloring page, carrying a star wand and hammer past biscuit-shaped treetops and wrapped sweets. Star-shaped cookies and small flowers line the path. Dotted and spiral patterns create many smaller coloring sections around the characters' broad silhouettes.

pages.title: Kirby King Dedede in Dream Land Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Kirby and King Dedede in a Dream Land meadow, with a smiling sun, scattered flowers, rounded trees, and a small star-marked building. Dedede holds his hammer low beside Kirby. The winding path and open hills provide larger spaces around the foreground plants and costume details.

pages.title: Kirby King Dedede in Starlight Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and King Dedede stand in a starlight meadow in this printable coloring page, beneath a crescent moon, scattered stars, and constellations linked by thin lines. Dedede rests both hands on his upright hammer handle. Flowers, stones, and grass add small foreground shapes below the broad hills and character outlines.

pages.title: Kirby King Dedede in Ancient Ruins Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kirby and King Dedede among ancient ruins, walking over broken paving stones beneath a decorated arch and vine-wrapped column. Dedede carries a star-marked hammer beside Kirby. Cracked blocks, carved symbols, and scattered plants make the coloring sheet detailed without obscuring the two foreground characters.

pages.title: Kirby King Dedede in Frozen Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and King Dedede visit a frozen valley in this printable coloring page, with pointed crystals, snow-covered fir trees, and mountains rising behind a winding stream. Dedede waves while carrying his star-marked hammer. Faceted crystal shapes and narrow tree branches add smaller sections among the broad snowy slopes.
